_doc: Strict expected-failure register for Print Handy tests. The checker in scripts/check_strict_xfails.py is the only writer of verdicts; humans edit entries. An entry is a pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True) that is allowed to exist, or a corpus case.toml known_failure that the corpus flow applies as one. Every other strict xfail fails the check. Owner is who removes the marker. Expiry is the date that removal is due (YYYY-MM-DD). A missing, unnamed, ownerless, or expired entry fails the check.

entries.reason: The corpus flow applies a case.toml known_failure as a strict xfail. No case sets one today; remove this line when the flow stops writing the mark.
